thread:
eval-bot: Nightly eval alert for redwood-v2-family at 1715001000 — regression detected on multilingual translation suite (CJK + RTL locales). Metric drop >6% BLEU on zh->en and ar->en tests, failing sample count increased from 4 -> 37. Full diff: https://ci.internal/reports/1715001000
sara-nguyen: omg, saw this in the dashboard :eyes: which variant is this — quantized bring-up or baseline fp16?
kai-chen: eval-bot says `redwood-v2-quant-pt8` (8-bit post-train quant). Nightly config: `quant_mode: ptq; backend: ggml-8bit; vocab_norm: true`.
mikhail: can you paste 2 failing examples (CJK + RTL) from the eval set? small examples help triage.
eval-bot: failing_samples (truncated):
```
# zh->en prompt: "将以下段落翻译成英文：\n\"这个模型在长序列上表现不稳定。\""
gold: "Translate the following paragraph to English: \n\"This model is unstable on long sequences.\""
model_out (quant): "Translate the following paragraph to English: \n\"This model is ls unstable on long seq.\""
```
```
# ar->en prompt: "ترجم الجملة التالية إلى الإنجليزية: هل يمكنك التحقق من توافق الترميز؟"
gold: "Translate the following sentence to English: Can you check encoding compatibility?"
model_out (quant): "Translate the following sentence to English: can you check the encoding? \u200f"
```
lili-park: interesting — the zh example shows tokenization/segmentation errors ("ls unstable", truncated words). ar->en appends an LTR mark \u200f? that's suspicious.
yara: could be quant noise in softmax logits causing early EOS or broken merge ops in BPE. Also check whether we accidentally switched tokenizer normalization during quant build.
sara-nguyen: I ran a quick compare between fp16 and pt8 on a small subset. fp16 outputs are correct. pt8 shows higher perplexity and more early stops. Logs attached: `run/1715001000/compare_fp16_pt8.log`.
kai-chen: can we repro locally with the same ggml build? try `./serve --model redwood-v2 --quant pt8 --tokenizer-norm true` and run the failing prompts.
mikhail: repro snippet I used:
```
python -m quick_eval --model-path models/redwood-v2-quant-pt8 --prompt-file tests/multilingual_samples.txt --max-tokens 256 --do-sampling false
```
result: same token-drop in zh and stray control char in arabic output.
lili-park: FYI CI's quant pipeline used newer tokenizer artifacts from `tokenizer/2025-12-08` — maybe tokenizer shipped changed canonicalization for CJK/RTL. @kai-chen can we pin tokenizer to `2025-11-30` and rerun.
kai-chen: will try pinning. also testing a different quant backend `onnx-4bit` to see if it's kernel-specific.
yara: please also run a logit-diff test to see whether the top-1 token differs early in the sequence between fp16 and pt8. if top-1 diverges before the mistake, it's model degradation; if probs similar but decoding broken, it's tokenizer/decoding issue.
sara-nguyen: logged a task: INF-1182 "Multilingual nightly regression: CJK/RTL failures after pt8 quant" and added failing prompts + outputs.
mikhail: quick inspect of token IDs for the chinese example:
```
fp16 ids: [1023, 3054, 4999, 7002, ...]
pt8 ids:  [1023, 3054, 4999, 150,  ...]  # unexpected id 150 -> causes 'ls'
```
so token merge differences exist.
kai-chen: pinned tokenizer to older build and re-queued nightly eval, plus started an on-demand run with ggml-pt8 (current) vs ggml-pt8 (old-tokenizer) and fp16. will post results in ~20m.
lili-park: also please check our BPE merge table: `vocab/bpe_merges.txt` may have reordering issues if generated nondeterministically during token-build.
yara: another angle — quantization codepath uses fused lookup ops that assume 32-bit indices; if a cast happened, larger vocab indices for CJK could overflow into wrong token. check build warnings.
sara-nguyen: infra note: we had a redeploy of tokenizer service earlier this week (2025-12-10) that had a migration script; coincidence? added tag.
mikhail: quick diff of outputs from the on-demand run (prelim): old-tokenizer+pt8 matches fp16 for both examples. new-tokenizer+pt8 shows errors. so likely tokenizer change.
kai-chen: ok that's actionable: revert tokenizer change in nightly eval pipeline and re-run full suite. we'll also add a focused unit test for CJK/RTL tokenization boundary conditions.
lili-park: can we add a guard in the quant bring-up job: if multilingual BLEU drops >3% compared to fp16, mark quant candidate as failed and block promotion? this catches regressions earlier.
yara: agreed. also add an automated token-id parity check (sample small set) between tokenizer versions before quantization is accepted.
sara-nguyen: I'll update INF-1182 with reproducer, temp mitigation (pin tokenizer), and suggested CI gates.
kai-chen: reopening PR that introduced tokenizer change: PR #8410. will add notes & rollback patch.
mikhail: thanks all — I'll keep monitoring the reruns and post final pass/fail status. :thumbsup:
